description: A Saved Filter allows users to store and reuse complex search criteria for various entities within the system, enabling quick access to frequently used queries.

endpoints.name: CreateSavedFilter
endpoints.description: Creates a new saved filter with specified criteria and a unique name for the current user.

request.description: The request body containing the details for the new saved filter, including its name, entity type, and filter criteria.

example_uses: How do I save a new filter for partners that are active?
Can you create a filter named 'High Priority Projects' for me?
I want to store a search query for future use, how do I do that?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when you want to persist a specific set of search criteria for later reuse, allowing users to quickly apply complex filters without re-entering them.

endpoints.name: UpdateSavedFilter
endpoints.description: Updates an existing saved filter's name or criteria based on the provided request.

request.description: The request body containing the updated details for the saved filter, identified by its ID, including new name or filter criteria.

example_uses: I need to modify the 'My Active Projects' filter to include a new status.
Update the criteria for the 'High Priority Tasks' filter to only show tasks assigned to me.
Can I change the name of my saved filter from 'Old Leads' to 'Archived Leads'?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when you need to change the details (name, description, criteria) of an already existing saved filter.

endpoints.name: DeleteSavedFilter
endpoints.description: Deletes a specific saved filter by its unique identifier.

id.description: The unique ID of the filter to delete.

example_uses: Delete the saved filter with ID 123.
Remove the 'Old Projects' filter from my saved list.
I no longer need this saved search, please delete it.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when you want to permanently remove a saved filter that is no longer needed.

endpoints.name: GetSavedFilter
endpoints.description: Retrieves the detailed information of a single saved filter by its unique ID.

id.description: The unique ID of the filter to retrieve.

example_uses: Get the details of saved filter 456.
Show me the criteria for the 'My Team's Tasks' filter.
What is the configuration of saved filter ID 789?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when you need to view the specific configuration or details of a single saved filter.

endpoints.name: GetSavedFilters
endpoints.description: Retrieves a paginated list of saved filters for the current user. This endpoint supports advanced filtering and pagination via the 'request' query parameter. The 'request' object can include 'searchCriteria' (an array of objects, each with 'field', 'operator', and 'value' properties) to filter results, along with 'pageIndex' and 'pageSize' for pagination.

request.description: Search and pagination parameters for retrieving saved filters. Can include 'searchCriteria' for filtering by fields like 'name' or 'entityType', and 'pageIndex'/'pageSize' for pagination.

example_uses: List all my saved filters.
Show me saved filters that apply to 'Projects'.
Get the second page of my saved filters, with 20 items per page.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when you need to retrieve a list of saved filters, optionally applying search criteria or pagination to narrow down the results.

endpoints.name: ApplySavedFilter
endpoints.description: Applies a saved filter by its ID and returns the corresponding filter request object, which can then be used to query the actual data. This endpoint also supports pagination parameters.

id.description: The unique ID of the filter to apply.

example_uses: Apply saved filter 123 and get the search query it represents.
I want to use the 'Active Partners' filter to get the search parameters for a query.
Generate the search request for filter ID 789, for page 1 with 50 results.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when you want to retrieve the actual search criteria (as a request object) defined within a saved filter, typically to then execute that search against another entity's data.

endpoints.name: GetFilterStatistics
endpoints.description: Retrieves usage statistics related to saved filters, optionally filtered by entity type.

entityType.description: Optional parameter to filter statistics by a specific entity type (e.g., 'Partner', 'Project').

example_uses: What are the statistics for saved filters?
Show me the usage statistics for saved filters related to 'Projects'.
How many times have filters been applied for 'Partners'?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when you need to gather analytical data or insights into how saved filters are being used within the system.
